tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Plain purple screen background on TV and phone (REQ-FL-45). Text on it: text, text-dim, accent.

tokens.name: bg-dark
tokens.usage: Info bars, dark panels, the quiet Back button fill. Same text colors as bg.

tokens.name: panel-light
tokens.usage: Lighter panel on the purple background.

tokens.name: button
tokens.usage: Default button fill, players badge, gear. White text on it is 5.2:1.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled button: flat, muted, no shadow. Use text-dim darkened for its label.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Thick outline on every card and button, and the base of the hard shadow. Also the dim layer behind modals at 72%.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Text on bg, bg-dark and button.

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg and bg-dark (help text, player range).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Titles, numbers, focus outline, primary button fill. Never a text color on button (too weak); never on white.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Good latency or success on the purple background.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Error, lost player border, slow latency. Pair with a word, not hue alone.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: White card fill (slots, modals, text inputs).

tokens.name: card-text
tokens.usage: Text on card, and on the accent primary button.

tokens.name: card-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text on card, 6:1 on white.

tokens.name: room
tokens.usage: The room code only.

tokens.name: card-ready
tokens.usage: The 'Ready!' state word on card. 3.4:1 on white: passes only at 28px semibold (large text); a real source pair kept exact.

tokens.name: slot-empty
tokens.usage: Dot color for an empty player slot.

tokens.name: shadow-ink
tokens.usage: The hard shadow color (outline at 45% alpha), lighter than the outline so it is not a second border.

tokens.name: confetti-pink
tokens.usage: Confetti burst on the logo screen.

tokens.name: confetti-cyan
tokens.usage: Confetti burst.

tokens.name: player-1
tokens.usage: Player slot 1 (red). Always shown with the slot number.

tokens.name: player-2
tokens.usage: Player slot 2 (teal).

tokens.name: player-3
tokens.usage: Player slot 3 (orange).

tokens.name: player-4
tokens.usage: Player slot 4 (blue).

tokens.name: world-blue
tokens.usage: Alternative game background (REQ-GM-48).

tokens.name: world-teal
tokens.usage: Alternative game background.

tokens.name: world-plum
tokens.usage: Alternative game background.

tokens.name: world-green
tokens.usage: Alternative game background.

tokens.name: world-amber
tokens.usage: Alternative game background.

tokens.name: brand-dark
tokens.usage: App icon ground.

tokens.name: brand-yellow
tokens.usage: App icon phone.

styles.name: meta

tokens.name: space-14

tokens.name: space-22

tokens.name: space-28

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Card horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-44
tokens.usage: Modal card padding.

tokens.name: safe-area
tokens.usage: TV screen margin (REQ-FL-41a).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Game tile and screenshot.

tokens.name: radius-slot
tokens.usage: Slot row.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Default card, button, input.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Players badge and gear (full round at 84px height).

tokens.usage: Hard offset shadow on cards and buttons, no blur (REQ-FL-38).
